picks.reason: Jackson LaCombe simply doesn't shoot much: the Bot projects 1.11 shots, well short of the line, off a blended rate of 1.1 across 25 games this season and 94 last. His weighted history leans the same way, with 57% of 72 games landing under 1.5. With less power-play time lately and SJ's defense both trimming slightly, the only push upward is a 2.4% league-wide scaling bump. What the price may be underweighting is his recent form, 1.41 shots a game over his last 5, which the Bot gives no weight. The Book's chance is 55.7% and the desk bets 56% against a 54.5% break-even at -120, an edge of just 1.5 points that comes from the price, and the desk's 226-267 record on this type and side says that margin is thin.
picks.risk: His last 5 games averaged 1.41 shots, a level the Bot ignores; if that shooting holds, two shots on goal sinks an under carrying only a 1.5-point edge.
